nodes.prompt:
Round 2 of 10 Evolutionary Multi-Agent Autonomous Orchestration:

Goal:
Implement Row Provenance Timeline, Interactive Edge Connection Badges with Drawer Routing, Unified Multi-File Diffs Aggregator Tab in GVUI, and Autonomous Meta-Orchestrator CLI Integration in Skills.

Work Breakdown:
1. Task T-01: GVUI Row Provenance & Execution Timeline (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/RawProvenanceTab.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/ProvenanceTimeline.tsx`)
   - Full chain of custody rendering actor IDs, validator lease token digests, attempt progressions, finding remediations, command links, and resolution paths.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

2. Task T-02: GVUI Interactive Edge Badges & Edge Detail Drawer Overhaul (`src/components/EdgeDetailDrawer/`, `src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx`)
   - Seamless routing from canvas edge badge click to the Edge Detail Drawer.
   - Display handoff payloads, token exchanges, step sequence, condition branch evaluations, and traffic volume.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/EdgeDetailDrawer && bun test src/primitives/edges`

3. Task T-03: GVUI Unified Multi-File Diffs Aggregator Tab (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/DiffsTab.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/DiffViewer.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/NodeDetailDrawerTabs.css`)
   - Merged multi-file diff viewer with collapsible file trees, syntax highlighting, and unified addition/deletion stats across task submissions and repair rounds.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

4. Task T-04: Skills Autonomous Meta-Orchestrator CLI Integration & Chaining (`skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/src/cli/commands/orchestrator-ops.ts`, `skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/src/cli/execute.ts`)
   - Wire `orchestrator:run` CLI command into `harness.ts` to trigger end-to-end multi-round evolutionary looping.
   - Gate: `bun test tests/unit/orchestrator`
